authorizer: SENTINEL (REPAIR-DEV-01 adjudication, directive 7-8: mechanical provider-failure taxonomy + arm-neutral infrastructure handling)
applicability: VALIDATION and HOLDOUT phases of the TERMINAL_FALSIFICATION campaign
purpose: Distinguish infrastructure events from experimental failures MECHANICALLY so provider instability cannot be misread as an architectural or prompting failure.

infrastructure_taxonomy.qualifying_infra_event: any LLM call in a network-dependent arm that returns SemanticInferenceFailure with failure_type in {provider_timeout, provider_api_error} (equivalently: runner.metrics.provider_failures increments)

EXPERIMENTAL_failures: malformed model action (PROMPTED_AGENT: _parse_prompted_action returns None -> model_failures += 1)
budget exhaustion (actions_dispatched >= ACTION_CAP=5 or iterations_used >= ITERATION_BUDGET=5 with objective unmet)
experimental_taxonomy.rule: EXPERIMENTAL failures are NEVER reclassified as INFRA. They are architectural/behavioral outcomes of the arm.

paired_infrastructure_validity.definition: A MATCHED COMPARISON is the set of all 4 arms at a fixed (family, seed) instance.
paired_infrastructure_validity.rule: If ANY network-dependent arm (FULL_RAPHAEL, PROMPTED_AGENT, NO_WORLD_MODEL) in the matched comparison records >= 1 QUALIFYING INFRA event, the entire matched comparison is marked INFRA_INVALID.
handling: INFRA_INVALID matched comparisons are excluded from the primary architecture-vs-prompting confirmatory comparison.
They are NOT counted as architectural failures and do NOT contribute to any arm's failure rate.
They are REPORTED in the validation/holdout provider-stability section (count, distribution by family, by arm).
No selective rerun of INFRA_INVALID cells.
paired_infrastructure_validity.rationale: Per SENTINEL: the DEV gap (PROMPTED 4.4 mean dispatches, 19/50 below-cap) is asymmetric provider starvation, not architecture-vs-prompting signal. Paired validity removes the confound without reruns.

prohibited_actions: Inspecting a bad result and rerunning it
Reclassifying model refusal / malformed action / loop / poor reasoning / wrong action / budget exhaustion as infrastructure
Reclassifying timeout / HTTP 429 / HTTP 5xx / connection failure as experimental
pre_registered_anchor: D-6C provider_failure_policy (no selective retry; PROVIDER_CONFOUNDED flagging) — extended to paired-comparison validity per SENTINEL directive 7.
